mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP above 2% annualized growth rate indicates a strong demand environment, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 4% indicates a tight labor market, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above 2% annualized growth rate indicates a strong supply environment, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between the federal funds rate and the consumer price index signals an inflationary environment, leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days when FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL is above 3%.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP and housing starts signals a strong demand environment, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when GDPC1 is above 2% and HOUST is above 1.2 million.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high GDP growth and housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A threshold-triggered signal is generated when the unemployment rate rises above 5%, indicating a weakening labor market, leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal is generated during a monetary tightening cycle, where an increase in the federal funds rate above 4% indicates a hawkish monetary policy, leading to lower S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
